assumptions: Tỷ VND. Nhà sản xuất hư cấu Vành Sương. Toy warranty assurance provision, product recall và insurance recovery ghi riêng; signed audit controlling, không tax ngoài số cho.

evidence.text: [P&L final] Revenue 960, production COGS 600, selling/admin 180 chưa gồm warranty expense; depreciation 40 riêng; finance cost 20, tax 18.
[Warranty ledger] Opening warranty provision 36; settlements 28 gồm 22 cash và 6 replacement parts từ inventory. Current product sales create expected obligations 45. Prior cohort estimate reduced 4.
[Recall] Separate confirmed obligation 30, not included in warranty ledger. Cash repairs 8 already settled; closing remaining recall provision22. No opening recall obligation.
[Insurance] Insurer confirms reimbursement 12 of recall cost, all recognition criteria met under toy; cash received 5. Separate receivable, other operating income, no offset.

[Cash] Customer receipts 940; ordinary production/selling cash paid 740 excluding warranty/recall settlement, finance cash20, tax cash16. No other operating cash. Replacement inventory6 is noncash settlement.
[Assets] Cash capex 70, direct noncash vendor-financed capex 15. Opening cash 80, borrowing cash 25, principal repayment10; no dividend.
[Draft] Controller treats entire 28 warranty settlement as current expense, ignores estimate release, offsets reimbursement against recall provision, adds vendor capex into cash outflow.
[Policy] Warranty expense = new estimate less prior release, not payment. Recall expense separate 30, insurance recovery income12. FCF=CFO−cash capex.

qas.question: Tính warranty expense của Vành Sương trước recall từ new estimate và release.
Roll-forward warranty provision riêng, sau cả cash và parts settlement?
Recall provision còn phải thanh toán cuối kỳ?
Gross provision tổng warranty và recall, chưa offset bảo hiểm?
Insurance receivable cuối kỳ khi 12 được xác nhận và thu5?
EBIT sau warranty/recall và recovery income riêng?
LNST theo expense và tax đã nêu của case recall?
Direct CFO khi warranty settlement gồm parts phi tiền?
FCF theo cash capex, loại equipment nhận trả chậm?
qas.answer: CFO = 940−740−22−8+5−20−16 = 139 tỷ VND. FCF = 139−70 = 69 tỷ; chỉ trừ capex tiền mặt, không trừ 15 tỷ tài sản mua bằng tài trợ phi tiền mặt.

qas.question: Ending cash khi có vay25, trả gốc10?
Gross capital additions gồm vendor finance, khác cash capex bao nhiêu?
Tại sao parts replacement6 giảm provision nhưng không phải current cash payment?
qas.answer: Settlement bằng inventory; carrying part giảm và liability giảm, không tiền ra lúc giao parts.

qas.question: Có ghi expense recall chỉ 18 vì insurer xác nhận12?
qas.answer: Không theo presentation quy định: expense30 và recovery income12 riêng. Net effect18 nhưng gross liability không offset.

qas.question: Có dự báo warranty cost rate của riêng sản phẩm recalled từ expense41/revenue960?
qas.answer: Không. 41 là aggregate warranty của tất cả sản phẩm, recall riêng; thiếu sales và claim cohort riêng.

qas.question: Nếu draft nói cash paid28 là expense warranty28, sửa cả timing lẫn amount thế nào?
qas.answer: Expense41 dựa trên nghĩa vụ mới45 trừ release4. Settlement28 sử dụng provision, gồm6 phi tiền, không ghi expense lần nữa.

qas.question: Có xác định insurer sẽ thanh toán đúng ngày nào phần7?
qas.answer: Không. Confirmed receivable không xác định settlement date; thiếu payment schedule.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Ngân hàng giả lập Sậy Vàng. Toy hai pool có phân loại rõ: A true sale derecognized, B secured borrowing retains loans. Gross carrying trước giao dịch, allowance separate. Không tax.

evidence.text: [Opening balances] Pool A gross loans 500, allowance 20; pool B gross 400, allowance 16. Other gross loans 4.100, allowance 164. Opening funding debt 1.000.

[Sale A] Cash proceeds 490, all control/risk transfer under toy, net carrying480 derecognized; bank retains separate servicing contract, fee 6 earned and cash collected this year. No retained credit risk.
[Financing B] Receives cash 350 against pledged loan pool, obligation principal350. Continues to recognize gross loans400 and allowance16. Interest on financing 14 expense and cash; no repayment.
[Other loans] New originations 600 cash; principal collections 450 cash on other loans. Allowance required closing other loans 180. No writeoff, FX or change to B allowance.
[Income] Interest income 310 excluding servicing; deposit funding interest120, operating cost140. These P&L items exclude transaction A gain, servicing, B finance interest and current other-loan ECL.
[Cash] Opening cash 200; cash interest received 300, funding interest120, operating cost135 paid. Loan flows and financing above complete, no other cash.
[Capital metric] Gross loan balance includes pledged pool B; loan-to-funding-debt ratio uses ending gross loans and opening funding debt plus B financing. Not regulatory LCR.
[Deck] Derecognizes both pools, treats both cash proceeds as revenue, calls retained servicing proof that A loans remain assets.

qas.question: Net carrying pool A at sale date là bao nhiêu?
Sale gain A theo true-sale classification?
Ending gross loans other book sau origination/collection?
Total closing gross loans sau cả A và B transactions?
Closing total allowance on remaining loans?
Current ECL charge riêng other loans?
Net loan carrying cuối kỳ theo cả pledged B và other book?
Closing funding debt after secured B financing?
PBT toy gồm gain A, servicing fee, B interest và current ECL?
Closing cash từ transaction proceeds, loan flows và operating cash?
Gross loan-to-funding-debt ratio theo note G?
Tại sao cash 350 B không phải sale consideration hoặc revenue?
qas.answer: B là secured borrowing, nhận cash và ghi debt350; loans400 vẫn thuộc balance.

qas.question: Servicing contract A có bắt buộc nhận lại gross loans500?
qas.answer: Không theo toy. A chuyển risk/control, servicing separate earned fee6 không giữ credit exposure.

qas.question: Có gọi allowance20 derecognized A là ECL release through P&L thêm20 ngoài gain10?
qas.answer: Không. Allowance20 đã nằm net carrying480 trong gain calculation; thêm release sẽ đếm hai lần.

qas.question: Có tính actual capital relief regulatory từ A sale?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu applicable rules, RWA, capital deductions và servicing exposure treatment.

qas.question: Có xác định fair value pledged B loans từ funding350?
qas.answer: Không. Loan advance là funding amount, không phải market valuation; thiếu collateral haircut/market evidence.

assumptions: Triệu USD. SaaS hư cấu Chấm Lửa. Toy reseller is principal on its own end-customer contracts; vendor recognizes only own net consideration. Signed amended contract controls over original offer. No tax.

evidence.text: [Original order] Reseller purchases vendor platform for 24 per year, January prepayment24. Vendor service starts Jan1. Original 12-month term, all ordinary service equally delivered.

[Signed amendment July1] Replace remaining six months of base service with expanded service for 18 total (includes original unearned12 plus additional6 billed and collected July1). Future service through Dec31. Treat prospectively; first six months unaffected.
[Refund note] Separate support add-on sold and collected 8 Jan1; canceled Oct1 after nine months service. Straight-line earned6, refunds unearned2 cash Oct1. No penalty.
[End-user reseller] Bills end customers 50, collects 46, incurs own marketing 5. Vendor has no rights to reseller's gross bills and does not control those contracts.
[Vendor cost] Platform direct cost 16, support cost3, R&D8, admin6 including SBC2; D&A4 separate. No other revenue, expense or taxes.
[Cash] All costs cash paid except SBC2 and D&A4; capex cash 5, opening cash9, no debt or other flows. All amendment and refund flows settled.
[Policy] Recurring vendor revenue from delivered platform plus support; gross end-customer bills not vendor sales. FCF=CFO−cash capex.
[Draft] Sales uses original24 plus amended18 plus support8; adds reseller end-user sales50 and treats refund2 as operating expense not revenue adjustment.

qas.question: Platform revenue Jan–Jun trước signed change?
Remaining platform consideration after amendment, bao gồm original unearned?
qas.answer: 18 triệu USD, không cộng12 lần nữa.

qas.question: Annual platform recognized revenue under prospective amendment?
Support add-on earned consideration after cancellation?
Total vendor earned revenue after refund, no reseller gross-up?
Total net cash from vendor customer transactions?
Vendor EBIT after direct cost, SBC and D&A?
Vendor EBITDA before D&A only?
Vendor cash operating surplus excluding noncash items?
Ending cash after stated investing spend?
qas.answer: CFO = 24+6+8−2−16−3−8−(6−2) = 5 triệu USD. Loại SBC2 và D&A4 khỏi chi tiền; trừ capex5, closing cash = 9+5−5 = 9 triệu USD.

qas.question: Closing base platform contract liability at Dec31?
qas.answer: 0, all amended consideration earned by Dec31.

qas.question: Vì sao original24 + amended18 overstated platform revenue?
qas.answer: 18 includes remaining original12. Correct annual revenue = first half12 + replacement18, not42.

qas.question: Có include reseller 50 gross billing khi vendor là platform supplier?
qas.answer: Không. Vendor không có quyền trên gross bills và không kiểm soát end-customer contract; own revenue36.

qas.question: Refund2 cho unearned support có phải operating expense riêng sau recognize8?
qas.answer: Không. 2 trả lại consideration chưa earned; chỉ earned6. Ghi revenue8 rồi expense2 sai scope.

qas.question: Có tính vendor ARR next year từ amended service18×2?
qas.answer: Không. Amendment hết Dec31, renewal term/pricing không được cung cấp.

qas.question: Có suy ra reseller EBIT bằng gross50−vendor36−marketing5?
qas.answer: Không. Chưa xác định reseller's recognized revenue, additional costs, support arrangements và timing.

assumptions: Tỷ VND, nghìn MWh equivalent. Utility hư cấu Lửa Bấc. Toy take-or-pay gas contract: minimum paid volume, unused paid units with enforceable makeup rights recorded prepaid asset. Expired rights expensed. No tax.

evidence.text: [Gas contract] Annual minimum100k units at 4 triệu VND/unit, actual delivery80k. Cash paid400 tỷ. Unused20k eligible makeup right next year; no refund.
[Opening makeup] Prior prepaid gas rights60 tỷ for 15k units. During current year 10k of these used (40 tỷ), separate from current deliveries80k. Remaining5k rights expire (20 tỷ).
[Production] Total gas consumed90k including prior makeup10k; electricity generated450k MWh, internal loss25k, delivered425k. Electricity price1.6 triệu/MWh.
[Cost] Other operating expense150, depreciation70, interest30; current gas expense includes actual current gas used, prior makeup consumed, prior expiry. No inventory left of delivered gas.
[Cash] Opening cash50, customer energy receipts640; other operating cash145, interest30 paid; cash capex55, no other flows.
[Receivables] Opening AR80, all earned electricity billed, no writeoffs. New makeup asset80 remains at year end; no other gas prepayment movement.
[Policy] Makeup rights on future gas separate prepaid asset; expiry loss current expense. Electricity earned on delivered MWh only.
[Draft] Expense whole gas payment400 plus prior use40; omits expired20, includes gross generation450 for revenue, assumes future makeups guaranteed irrespective of contract validity.

qas.question: Tính current contract gas delivery cost for 80k units?
Current unused minimum payment creates prepaid asset bao nhiêu?
Prior makeup expense split used and expired, total released?
Total gas expense current P&L including expiry?
Closing makeup prepaid asset after prior release and new rights?
Electricity sales actual delivered?
Internal energy loss rate on gross generated?
EBIT sau gas expiry, operating and depreciation?
PBT current theo gas obligation model?
Closing billed electricity AR?
CFO based on minimum cash payment rather than expense?
Closing cash after capex?
Tại sao gas expense380 không bằng cash payment400?
qas.answer: Current unused80 prepaid; prior rights60 released to expense (40 used,20 expired), net expense20 less than cash.

qas.question: Có nhận revenue720 bằng gross 450×1,6?
qas.answer: Không. 25k internal loss không delivered; earned only 425×1,6=680.

qas.question: Có khẳng định toàn bộ80 prepaid sẽ được sử dụng năm sau?
qas.answer: Không. Quyền enforceable hiện tại không bảo đảm actual usage; cần forecast gas demand/expiry.

qas.question: Có tính gross thermal efficiency từ 90k gas-equivalent và 450k electricity nếu không có conversion definitions?
qas.answer: Không. Units 'equivalent' chưa cho energy basis/calorific value; không diễn giải ratio như physical efficiency.
